content.Viajar con tu mascota a otro país puede: Travelling abroad with your pet can raise many questions. We provide specialised veterinary guidance and solutions tailored to your destination, helping you understand what's required and how to prepare.
content.Obtén la certificación oficial para tu S: Get official Service Dog certification with professional guidance and a reliable process. Learn about the requirements, registration and legal benefits so your assistance dog is properly identified and recognised.

content.Resolvemos las dudas más frecuentes sobr: Answers to common questions about the documents and requirements for travelling with your pet.
content.¿Qué documentación necesita mi mascota p: What documents does my pet need to travel?
content.Los requisitos dependen del país de dest: Requirements depend on the destination, country of origin and travel date. We review your case and explain which documents, vaccinations, certificates or tests your pet needs before travelling.
content.El CEXGAN es la documentación oficial ne: CEXGAN provides official documentation required for certain international pet journeys from Spain. We review the requirements and manage the relevant documents for your trip.
content.¿Necesito una serología de rabia?: Do I need a rabies antibody test?
content.Depende del país de destino. Algunos paí: It depends on the destination. Some countries require a rabies antibody test after vaccination and within specific timeframes. We review your case to confirm whether it is needed and when it should be done.
content.¿Puedo obtener el pasaporte europeo para: Can I get a European pet passport?
content.Sí. Podemos ayudarte con la gestión del: Yes. We can help arrange a European pet passport for dogs, cats and ferrets, and check that the microchip identification and vaccinations are correctly recorded.
content.¿Cuánto tiempo antes del viaje debo empe: How far in advance should I start the paperwork?
content.Recomendamos empezar a preparar la docum: We recommend starting well in advance, as some destinations require vaccinations, rabies tests or waiting periods. The sooner we review your case, the easier it is to organise everything.
content.¿Podéis realizar la vacunación y el micr: Can you provide vaccinations and microchipping at home?
content.Sí. Dependiendo de la zona, podemos gest: Yes. Depending on your area, we can arrange at-home veterinary services such as vaccinations, microchipping and other procedures needed to prepare your pet for travel.
content.No. iPawsport se centra en la preparació: No. iPawsport focuses on preparing and managing the veterinary documents needed to travel with your pet. Transport, flights, import arrangements and quarantine are the owner's responsibility.
content.¿Cómo puedo saber qué necesita mi mascot: How can I find out what my pet needs to travel?
content.Solo tienes que indicarnos a dónde viaja: Tell us where and when you're travelling and share a few details about your pet. Our veterinary team will review your case and explain the steps needed to prepare for the journey.
